Demonic scream and groan sound effect

Source: Male Screams [1] by marc3122 (a recorded human vocal performance)
https://freesound.org/people/marc3122/sounds/556976/
Original publication: February 5, 2021
License: Creative Commons Zero 1.0 Universal (CC0)
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
Verified on October 21, 2026.

Number Garden modifications: scream and grunt excerpts; lead pitched to 64%,
low body to 40%, and trailing groan to 55% of their original sample rates;
equalization, compression, soft saturation, short room echoes, peak limiting,
fades, and MP3 encoding. Duration: 3.20 seconds. Reworked October 22, 2026.
The speech/voice is not AI-generated. No text-to-speech or synthesized vocal
oscillators are used in this effect.

The source permits copying, modifying, and distributing the sound, including
commercial use. Attribution is provided voluntarily.
Rebuild instructions: python3 scripts/build-scream.py (requires ffmpeg).
